## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor with sample dimensions flattened to one |

## Settings

The node has no settings.

## Usage

```text
Preserves batch dimension: (N, C, H, W) -> (N, C*H*W).
```

## Tips

- Place between last Conv/Pool and first Dense.
- Consider GlobalAvgPool as alternative.
